title: Isoimperatorin improves osteoporosis by increasing YBX1 expression to promote BGLAP m5C modification.
authors: Hu, Guang; Wen, Jing; Yang, Hao; Zhang, Kaiwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物ISO通过YBX1调控BGLAP的m5C修饰改善骨质疏松，属于RNA修饰与疾病机制研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoporosis is a chronic metabolic bone disease that is prone to fractures. Isoimperatorin (ISO) has been shown to alleviate the bone loss in ovariectomized (OVX) rats. The aim of this study was to investigate the effect and the mechanism of ISO on osteoporosis using animal study and cell experiments. Osteogenic differentiation was assessed by alkaline phosphatase activity detection, and alizarin red S staining. The expression of osteogenic differentiation-related genes and m5C regulators was measured using quantitative real-time PCR. Hematoxylin eosin (H&E) staining and microCT were performed to evaluate osteoporosis in vivo. The m5C levels in mice were measured by dot blot assay, and the binding between ISO and YBX1 was assessed by biolayer interferometry (BLI) analysis and molecular docking. Methylated RNA immunoprecipitation was performed to identify the target gene of YBX1. The interaction between YBX1 and BGLAP was assessed using RIP and luciferase reporter assay. Results suggested that ISO significantly promoted osteogenic differentiation of MC3T3 cells and alleviated osteoporosis in OVX mice. Moreover, ISO increased m5C level and YBX1 expression in OVX mice, while YBX1 knockdown inhibited osteogenic differentiation in ISO-treated MC3T3 cells, and restored osteoporosis in OVX mice ameliorated by ISO. Additionally, YBX1 knockdown inhibited the m5C level of BGLAP through inhibiting its mRNA stability. In conclusion, we demonstrated that ISO improved osteoporosis through increasing YBX1 expression thereby upregulating the m5C modification of BGLAP. These results may provide a novel theoretical basis for ISO treatment of osteoporosis.
abstract_zh: 骨质疏松症是一种易发生骨折的慢性代谢性骨病。异欧前胡素（ISO）已被证明可缓解去卵巢（OVX）大鼠的骨丢失。本研究旨在通过动物实验和细胞实验探讨ISO对骨质疏松症的作用及其机制。通过碱性磷酸酶活性检测和茜素红S染色评估成骨分化。使用定量实时PCR测量成骨分化相关基因和m5C调控因子的表达。进行苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色和microCT以评估体内骨质疏松症。通过斑点印迹实验测量小鼠中的m5C水平，并通过生物层干涉法（BLI）分析和分子对接评估ISO与YBX1之间的结合。进行甲基化RNA免疫沉淀以鉴定YBX1的靶基因。使用RIP和荧光素酶报告基因实验评估YBX1与BGLAP之间的相互作用。结果表明，ISO显著促进了MC3T3细胞的成骨分化，并缓解了OVX小鼠的骨质疏松症。此外，ISO增加了OVX小鼠中的m5C水平和YBX1表达，而YBX1敲低抑制了ISO处理的MC3T3细胞中的成骨分化，并逆转了ISO改善的OVX小鼠骨质疏松症。另外，YBX1敲低通过抑制BGLAP的mRNA稳定性来降低其m5C水平。总之，我们证明ISO通过增加YBX1表达从而上调BGLAP的m5C修饰来改善骨质疏松症。这些结果可能为ISO治疗骨质疏松症提供新的理论基础。
